title: ABBA Evidence and Source Intelligence Fabric
rules: A source assessment is not truth.
Consensus does not automatically establish truth.
Multiple copies of one source are not independent corroboration.
Stale sources remain provenance-preserved but require reassessment.
External observations are observations with provenance and reality state, not automatic canonical fact.
Contradictory evidence remains represented rather than silently discarded.
Evidence-chain confidence is an assessment, not a truth claim.
authorityBoundary: Evidence and source intelligence cannot authorize consequential execution.
